paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 5.86, with a decrease of 5.26% from the prior close and 11.15% over the last 22 sessions.

The recent news headlines are focused on the company's CEO departure, financial performance, and project updates. A filing with the SEC stated that CEO Toby Neugebauer had left the company as of April 17, 2026, and an Interim Office of the CEO had been set up. The company also reported expectations to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year and shared updates on its Project Matador initiative.

There have been 25 total filings, including 1 Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
